text:
rachna: quick Q — for the hosting abstraction RFC, what's the canonical place we store tenant creds for hosted vs private? we have half a dozen ad-hoc flows.
leo: short answer: control plane stores encrypted blobs for hosted; private uses customer KMS + local secrets. but we need a clean interface.
samira: +1. propose an abstraction: CredentialProvider interface with methods fetch(key) and attest(token), plus metadata flags like supports_rotation/supports_attest.
rachna: sketch it out? also need rotation hooks and audit log expectations. hosted customers expect us to rotate; private customers manage rotation.
leo: agree. my worry: if we put rotation in the provider interface, private deployments will pass-through and our control plane can't rotate.
samira: that's ok — add capability flags: supports_rotation, supports_remote_audit, supports_import_export. runtime adapters can declare them.
mike: potential runtime impact: calls per-request? should we cache per-request? caching implies we hold decrypted secret in memory; SRE concerns about memory lifetime and scrapeable metrics.
infra-bot: deploy-trigger:credential-abstraction-proto v1 submitted by samira — CI checks running :white_check_mark:.
rachna: for hosted, we also have to expose a limited API for tenant credential introspection for billing reconciliation; must ensure no secrets leak.
leo: proposal: separate Attestation token vs Secret payload. Attestation can be public-ish (signed) and used for meta ops; secrets stay local. That keeps runtime checks cheap.
samira: sample interface:
```
interface CredentialProvider {
  fetchSecret(tenant_id, key, purpose): EncryptedBlob
  attest(tenant_id, purpose): AttestationToken
  rotate(key): RotationResult
  capabilities(): ["rotate","attest","import"]
}
```
rachna: +1. need to add error semantics: transient vs fatal to allow graceful fallback to cached credential or alternative provider.
leo: fallback policy: control-plane tries hosted provider, if transient error -> use cached, if fatal or not supported -> fallback to dedicated/private-compatible provider and emit alert.
mike: ops checklist: memory encryption for in-process keys, TTL on caches, circuit breaker metrics, and a red-team test for interception.
rachna: timeline? samira can you produce a short RFC PR with interface + sample runtime adapter and an integration test across hosted/dedicated/private sim.
samira: will do this week. i'll include snippet for local KMS adapter and hosted-svc adapter.
leo: add docs for what "supports_remote_audit" requires from infra team (audit sink shape, retention, and signing).
rachna: thanks — this unblocks the token-handling refactor we wanted. :thumbsup:
